description: Run the Nexscope interactive cutout create/info flow as one API API call. The point list marks foreground/background guidance points.

fields.name: imageUrl
fields.description: Public URL of the image to cut out.

fields.name: pointList
fields.description: Selection points. Each item should include x, y, and isSelect.

fields.name: scoreUrl
fields.description: Optional score map URL returned by a previous step.

fields.name: featureUrl
fields.description: Optional feature map URL returned by a previous step.
